messages:
inc-bot: ALERT: High paging/latency spike detected in us-west-2. Multiple model load failures (OOM / deserialization / compile-timeouts). Paging oncall-maria. Severity: P1 :rotating_light:

oncall-maria: I'm on it. seeing elevated 5xxs to /v1/generate and increased p99 latency. grabbing logs now.

ryan: I just got paged too, standing by for context. any customer impact metrics?

oncall-maria: initial triage: ~12% 5xx rate for hosted API in us-west-2 over last 7m, errors concentrated on requests that triggered model warmups for large models (redwood-xxl).

eng-runtime-lee: adding context — we deployed kernel selection patch at 03:12, but not sure it's related. seeing rapid container restarts on nodes gpunode-12/14. docker logs show repeated CUDA driver errors then OOM. excerpt:

```

E tensorflow: cudart returned 2: out of memory
ModelLoad: deserialize shard 3 failed: EOF while reading artifact
CompileStage: timed out after 90s
Container: kill signal 137
```

sre-jen: node-level metrics: GPU memory pressure spikes then host OOM on a few nodes, kernel logs show nv_peer_mem errors. network filesystem latency also high which could cause deserialize timeouts.

oncall-maria: immediate mitigation attempts — rolling restart of affected nodes to clear driver state? thoughts?

eng-runtime-lee: prefer to avoid broad restarts. two mitigations we can do quickly: 1) route traffic away from affected AZ (us-west-2a) to other regions (low-risk) 2) enable automatic fallback to smaller model variant redwood-large-fallback for new requests that would warmup xxl. both are doable now.

ryan: route traffic first. put a short canary that sends 50% new warmup requests to fallback, 50% to original until we confirm stability. set retention window to 5m.

oncall-maria: executing region-level reroute now — disabling new warmups in us-west-2a and routing to us-west-2b/c. updating routing policy.

deploy-bot: Deploy manifest updated: route-policy=us-west-2a->reduced, new-canary=50% -> redwood-large-fallback.

cs-alex: FYI some enterprise customers in us-west reported degraded responses earlier. I'm opening a PG to notify impacted orgs with ETA and mitigation steps.

eng-runtime-lee: while reroute happens, I'm going to blacklist the artifact shard that failed deserialization on gpunode-12 to avoid repeated retries: `artifact-blacklist add sha256:deadbeef shard:3`. Also lowering concurrent warmup limit from 6 -> 2 on affected hosts.

sre-jen: I've increased host-level swap and set oom_score_adj to favor restarting the process rather than killing the container host. also moved aggressive kube-probes to be less sensitive to transient IO stalls.

oncall-maria: after reroute + fallback canary, 5xx rate dropped to 3% within 4m. p95 latency still elevated on a few requests.

eng-runtime-lee: found more detailed logs from model loader: `deserialize: got 0 bytes, expected 1.2GB` — points to NFS timeouts or partial artifact reads. compile service logs show burst of compile jobs queued, several hitting 90s timeout.

ryan: could compile timeouts be due to kernel selection patch? maybe it triggers a slower path. we should disable the new kernel selector in the canary region until we confirm.

eng-runtime-lee: disabling kernel-selector in canary now. also bumping compile concurrency limiter to reduce queueing.

oncall-maria: note — one node (gpunode-14) still in crashloop with driver core dumps. SRE is isolating and taking it out of rotation.

sre-jen: node isolated. we observed nvml: GPU reset required and multiple coredumps in /var/crash. filing host incident for hardware noise.

deploy-bot: Traffic rebalancer: 100% of new warmup requests now going to fallback for 10m window.

cs-alex: Customer comms draft posted to PG: short note + workaround (retry) + ETA 1h for stabilization. requesting approvals.

oncall-maria: current status: error rate down to ~1.2%, p99 latency back to within SLO for non-warmup traffic. partial customer impact persists — some long-running requests still hitting slower backend due to queued compile jobs.

eng-runtime-lee: root vectors we suspect: 1) artifact read failures due to NFS latency -> deserialization EOF 2) driver-level GPU faults causing host OOMs 3) aggressive concurrent warmups + compile concurrency causing queueing & timeouts.

ryan: next steps (short term): keep fallback in place, isolate bad nodes, disable kernel-selector, limit concurrent warmups cluster-wide to 2, and throttle compile service. SRE to continue node recovery.

sre-jen: started artifact integrity sweep for recently-published shards to rule out corruption. running `sha256sum --check` on candidate artifacts. so far everything checks out on artifacts pulled from s3.

eng-runtime-lee: good. if artifacts look clean, NFS client-side timeouts are still possible. we'll increase read timeout and add more aggressive retry with exponential backoff in the loader.

noncall-maria: handoff — I need to go offline for 30m. ryan will take next oncall handover. ryan, you're the incident lead from here.

ryan: taking over. summary for the log: P1 in us-west-2 causing model warmup failures due to a mix of deserialization EOFs, compile timeouts, and GPU driver faults. mitigations: traffic reroute, fallback model, blacklist bad shard, reduce warmup concurrency, disable kernel-selector, isolate nodes.

ryan: immediate asks for eng-runtime: please add a short-term patch to loader to fail-fast on partial reads and trigger backoff rather than retrying aggressively. for infra: add a transient NFS circuit-breaker and increase read timeout. for SRE: continue host recovery and post hardware ticket for gpunode-14.

eng-runtime-lee: ack. I'll open a follow-up JIRA for loader backoff and compile throttling. estimated fix PR in 2-4h.

sre-jen: ack. host ticket opened: HT-4091. procuring logs for hardware vendor.

cs-alex: customer comms queued and will go out once we have confirmed no customer-visible errors in the next 30m.

ryan: action items captured. I'll create the incident page and assign owners for postmortem. please paste any logs / commands used here for the timeline.

eng-runtime-lee: pasting key commands used:
```
kubectl cordon gpunode-14
artifact-blacklist add sha256:deadbeef shard:3
kubectl patch deployment redwood-inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value","value":"2"}]'  # warmup concurrency
```

noncall-maria: leaving note: will update timeline when I return. great job team. :thumbsup:

ryan: logged. incident remains P1 — monitoring for 60m before downgrade. new lead is ryan.

inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P1 | us-west-2 | Reduced error rates, mitigation in place (traffic reroute, fallback). Next update in 30m or on change.
